resources.string: Pair in Galaxy Wearable first. Install matching Jugg phone and watch editions, then enable Wear OS in the phone app’s exchange settings. Phone sampling can stay on the phone.
Unable to check phone connection. Try refreshing.
Google Play services are unavailable. The current phone sync transport requires them on both devices.
No phone detected. Check pairing and the phone’s Wear OS switch.
Sync requested. Wait for samples from the phone; requesting is not confirmation of delivery.
App notifications are enabled. Set glucose alerts in Alerts.
App notifications are disabled. Enable them to receive glucose alerts.
On Galaxy Watch8 / modern Wear OS, add a Jugg glucose complication to a compatible watch face. This app edition provides the viewer, alerts and complications.
